title: fw ledger CLI: list, show, next, close
description: CLI commands over the fold view: fw ledger list --lane, show <id>, next (next ready row per lane), close <id> --probe (only if probe passes).
acceptance: fw ledger next prints one row whose dependencies are done
fw ledger close refuses when the probe fails
core_adaptation: fw ledger close is how the human-merge path in C0 finishes a row (verifying to done with a post-merge evidence bundle).
